parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: The zone's id, `SITE-AREA-ZONE` — exactly the first three segments of every LocationCode inside it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0019). Clients MUST always send a non-empty, unique-per-submit key: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent or empty key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`. A replay with the same key and the same body returns the original response verbatim; the same key with a different body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`.
